The '''Eastern Grime''' was a region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], surrounded by the [[Evocii swamp]], the [[Bog]], the [[Rust Yards]] and the [[Fa'athra's Palace|palace]] of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Voontara Fa'athra|Fa'athra]]. At the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the Eastern Grime was home to various [[Evocii]] tribes.<ref name="TOR" />
